hypotheses.Y1_original_score_correlation: For original concepts, frozen-32 score correlation with the full quadratic form is at least 0.70 median on every corpus.
hypotheses.Y2_heldout_score_correlation: For held-out concepts, frozen-32 score correlation is at least 0.50 median on every corpus.
hypotheses.Y3_original_executable_fidelity: For original concepts, raw centered reconstruction R-squared is at least 0.50 median on every corpus.
hypotheses.Y4_per_concept_semantic_retention: At least 75% of eligible held-out concepts per corpus retain oriented AUROC within 0.05 of the full form.
hypotheses.Y5_cross_term_fidelity_gain: Frozen full-quadratic score correlation exceeds diagonal-only correlation by at least 0.20 median for both concept groups on every corpus.
